name: dream-loop
title_zh: 渲染图即验收标准，代码先过视觉关
tagline_zh: 你说一句“dream loop”，它从描述生成游戏/应用，并让实况截图与预渲染图逐像素对齐。适合对图形保真有执念。
tagline_en: Say "dream loop" — it builds an app from your description, then iterates until the live screenshot matches the.
desc_en: Build a game or app from a description so that a live screenshot matches a generated rendering. Use when the user says "dream loop" or asks for something built to a very high level of graphical fidelity.
why_zh: 它把“图形保真”变成可执行的闭环：先渲染目标图，再驱动代码修改，直到截图比对通过。
why_en: It turns "high fidelity" into a closed loop: render a target, drive code changes, verify by screenshot diff. No vague asks — the.
limit_zh: 只认图形界面产物（游戏/应用）；纯后端或 CLI 工具它不接。需要能跑 GUI 的环境，且每次迭代都要真实截屏。
limit_en: GUI-only (games/apps); won't touch backend or CLI. Needs a display for real screenshots — headless servers can't run it.
title_en: Render match as acceptance, code must pass the visual
